## 0. 基本信息 / Basic Information

要在 **R** 中使用色盲友好的调色板，主要需要以下几个包。请务必在保存图片之前，用这些包检查过图。谢谢！

To use colorblind-friendly palettes in **R**, you mainly need the following packages. Be sure that we checked the plots with these packages before saving the plots. Thank you!

## 1. 色盲模拟（colorblindr） / 1. colorbindr

> 在可用于生产的 R 图形中模拟色盲效果。作者：Claire D. McWhite 与 Claus O. Wilke。

> Simulate colorblindness in production-ready R figures. Written by Claire D. McWhite and Claus O. Wilke.

官方仓库：<https://github.com/clauswilke/colorblindr>

Official repo: <https://github.com/clauswilke/colorblindr>

### 1.1 安装 / 1.1 Installation




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
remotes::install_github("wilkelab/cowplot")
install.packages("colorspace", repos = "http://R-Forge.R-project.org")
remotes::install_github("clauswilke/colorblindr")
```
:::




也可以通过以下方式安装：（但你需要先安装 [**pak**](https://github.com/r-lib/pak)。

It could also be installed with: (but you need to install [**pak**](https://github.com/r-lib/pak)first.




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
pak::pkg_install("clauswilke/colorblindr")
```
:::




### 1.2 演示 / 1.2 Demo

按照官方文档操作很容易，首先创建一个如下的 ggplot 对象：

It is easy to follow the official document, first make a ggplot object like:




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(ggplot2)
fig <- ggplot(iris, aes(Sepal.Length, fill = Species)) + geom_density(alpha = 0.7)
fig
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](index_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-4-1.png){width=100%}
:::
:::




然后我们可以用这个包在不同的模拟条件下进行检查：

Then we could use this package to check in different simulations:




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(colorblindr)
cvd_grid(fig)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](index_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-5-1.png){width=100%}
:::
:::




也可以在交互式应用中查看它，这里我只展示脚本，它不会为读者打开新的标签页。

It is also possible to inspect it in the interactive app, I just show the script, it will not open a tab for readers.




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
view_cvd(fig) # starts the interactive app
```
:::




# 2. 调色板检查（colorblindcheck） / 2. colorblindcheck

> 检查调色板是否存在与色觉缺陷有关的问题

> Check Color Palettes for Problems with Color Vision Deficiency

官方仓库：<https://github.com/Nowosad/colorblindcheck>

Official repo: <https://github.com/Nowosad/colorblindcheck>

### 2.1 安装 / 2.1 Installation




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
install.packages("colorblindcheck")
```
:::




### 2.2 演示 / 2.2 Demo




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(colorblindcheck)
rainbow_pal = rainbow(n = 7)
rainbow_pal
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] "#FF0000" "#FFDB00" "#49FF00" "#00FF92" "#0092FF" "#4900FF" "#FF00DB"
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
#> [1] "#FF0000" "#FFDB00" "#49FF00" "#00FF92" "#0092FF" "#4900FF" "#FF00DB"
palette_check(rainbow_pal, plot = TRUE)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}

:::
